newsitem.title: THAILAND: Somprasong denies bad debt rumours.
newsitem.headline: Somprasong denies bad debt rumours.

text.p: Thai property company Somprasong Land, hit since Thursday by rumours of financial difficulties, said on Friday it was able to continue operating despite a failure to raise capital from a potential rights issue.

"The company's liabilities are 42 percent of the company's total assets. The company is therefore still able to continue its business operation and has still received financial support from financial institutions," it said in a filing to the stock exchange.
